_schema.event_type: unbundling | tiering | menu-removal | fee-increase | negative | non-event
_schema.superset_flag: true when the only route buys extras (interval publication)
_schema.sources: primary or strongest available; full evidence in the archive

events.event: End of 'bags fly free' — first two checked bags no longer included (policy since ~1971); $35 first / $45 second
events.line_item: first bag $35/way, second $45/way (booked/ticketed/changed on or after date); Choice Extra & A-List Preferred keep 2, A-List & Rapid Rewards cardmembers keep 1
sources: swamedia.com 'Southwest Airlines Outlines Charges for Checked Baggage'

events.event: Bag fees raised to $45 / $55 amid jet-fuel spike
events.line_item: +$10 per bag on the 2025 line item
sources: swamedia.com 'Checked Bag Fee Update Effective April 9' (2026-04-07)

events.event: Industry bag-fee wave: UA $45/$50 (4/3), DL $45/$55 (4/8), AA $45/$55 prepaid $50/$60 airport (4/9), AS+Hawaiian $45/$55 (4/10), B6 peak/off-peak $39-49 / $59-69 +$10 airport (3/31)
events.line_item: per-carrier first/second bag fees; B6 requires date-dependent (peak-calendar) pricing

events.event: Basic Economy checked bags priced $5 above Main Cabin ($55/$65 online) — first US fare-class-conditional price for an identical physical service
sources: news.aa.com 'American Airlines updates bag fees and Basic Economy fares' (2026)

events.event: Domestic Basic Economy excludes full-size carry-on (personal item only); gate charge $75 ($50 bag fee + $25 gate handling; $65 before 2026-04-03)
events.line_item: Basic-to-Economy same-flight spread (~$43-65/way, 2026 surveys); gate charge prices a different attribute (bag checked, not in cabin) and is excluded by the equivalence protocol

events.event: Forced migration of 8M+ lines (Simple Choice/ONE/Magenta/legacy Sprint) to Experience tiers; ~1,100 plan codes retired, no opt-out; avg +$4/line (voice +$6, watch/tablet +$3, home internet +$6)
events.line_item: cheapest same-carrier current-menu plan weakly dominating the frozen plan-feature vector; published plan-to-plan crosswalk archived pre-migration

events.event: Ad tier launched at the old ad-free price ($7.99) while ad-free moved to $10.99; ad-free ladder: $13.99 (2023-10) -> $15.99 (2024-10) -> $18.99 (2025-10-21), ads $11.99
events.line_item: ad-free minus ads spread: $3.00 at launch, $7.00 by late 2025; day-one restoration relative +37.5%
cheapest ad-free minus ads spread (~$11/mo by 2026-03)

events.event: Out-of-household profiles become a paid 'extra member' slot ($7.99 at launch) — formerly included capability, now a line item
Overdraft/NSF fee revenue fell >50% from 2019 to ~$5.8B (2023); other checking fees flat
events.line_item: falling named fees — enters as a negative restoration series (negative control)
